explanation: In Germany, beckoning someone with your index finger is seen as condescending and disrespectful, akin to calling a dog. It is generally reserved for summoning animals or children, not adults in social or professional settings.
local_tip: To call someone over politely, use an open hand with palm facing down and wave all fingers together, or simply approach them directly.

also_check.note: Beckoning with the index finger is considered very rude; instead, use an open hand with palm down and a gentle waving motion.
Beckoning with a finger is highly offensive and can be seen as a challenge; use a hand gesture with palm down and fingers moving together.
While common among friends, it can be perceived as rude or dismissive in formal contexts; a verbal invitation is safer.
